# Convert WebP to PNG

- Route: `/tools/convert-webp-to-png`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `image`
- Slug: `convert-webp-to-png`

## Summary

Turn WebP images into lossless PNG files that open everywhere and keep full transparency. (Image tools)

## Details

WebP is great for the web, but plenty of editors, older software, and design tools still expect PNG — and unlike JPG, PNG keeps full transparency. Media Manipulator converts your WebP to a clean, lossless PNG so it opens everywhere and your alpha channel survives.
### What it does
- Converts any .webp image to a lossless .png file.
- Preserves the alpha channel so transparent WebPs stay transparent.
- Produces a PNG that opens in any editor, viewer, or design tool.
- The picture is unchanged; WebP compression is swapped for lossless PNG storage.
### How to use it
1. Upload WebP: Drop in a .webp file, transparent or solid.
2. Convert to PNG: We decode the WebP and re-encode it as PNG.
3. Encode PNG: ImageMagick writes a lossless 24/32-bit PNG.
4. Download PNG: Save a transparency-preserving .png file.
### Supported formats
- Input: webp
- Output: png
- Transparency is preserved. Only the first frame of an animated WebP is converted.
### Technical details
- Transparency in the source WebP is preserved as a PNG alpha channel.
- Only the first frame of an animated WebP becomes a still PNG — for animation, convert to GIF instead.
- PNG is lossless, so the output is usually larger than the source WebP; that is the cost of universal compatibility and lossless storage.
### Use cases
- Opening WebP in editors: Convert to PNG so an editor that lacks WebP support can open it.
- Keeping transparency: Preserve a transparent WebP logo as a transparent PNG.
- Design handoffs: Hand a PNG to tools or teammates that expect PNG assets.
- Presentations: Drop a PNG into slide software that won’t accept WebP.
### FAQ
Q: How do I convert WebP to PNG for free?
A: Upload your .webp above and click convert. The download is a lossless .png with transparency preserved. It is free and needs no signup.
Q: Does WebP to PNG keep transparency?
A: Yes. If your WebP has a transparent background, the resulting PNG keeps that alpha channel intact.
Q: Why convert WebP to PNG instead of JPG?
A: PNG is lossless and preserves transparency, while JPG flattens transparency and adds compression. Choose PNG when you need transparency or lossless graphics; choose JPG for the smallest photo files.
Q: Can I convert an animated WebP?
A: Only the first frame becomes a PNG. For animation, convert the WebP to an animated GIF instead.
